concerns.text: FR-13 cites '(See US-03 AC5)' but US-03 has only four acceptance criteria (AC1-AC4). Stale cross-reference; either add an AC5 to US-03 or correct the citation.

SC-001 states US-01 is successful 'when FR-001 - FR-009 are satisfied', but FR-005 (stratification), FR-006 (three annotators), and FR-007 (Cohen's Kappa) are US-02 requirements with no role in US-01's acceptance criteria. This contradicts SC-002, which correctly scopes US-02 to FR-006-FR-009/FR-015, and silently widens US-01's scope. SC-001 should reference FR-001-FR-004 (and FR-008's statistical thresholds) only.
